title: A4988 stepper driver
prompt: an A4988 stepper driver on a breadboard driving a NEMA17 motor: set the current limit with the trimpot, choose full step or 1/16 microstep, then step the motor; see-through labels the chip, current-sense resistors, trimpot, microstep pins and coil outputs
blurb: Turn the trimpot to set the A4988's current limit, move the MS jumpers between full step and 1/16 microstep, and send 200 STEP pulses to watch a NEMA17 turn a full revolution or one dial tick.
